title: Use a fallback for NULL
summary: PL/SQL: Use a fallback for NULL. Set name to Asha.
introduction: NULL means no value. NVL chooses a fallback when its first input is NULL.
learningObjectives: Use a fallback for NULL with PL/SQL

blocks.text: Use an Oracle practice database and SQL Developer Run Script or SQL*Plus. Run the whole block, including SET SERVEROUTPUT ON and the final slash. The result shown is DBMS_OUTPUT text.

blocks.title: Use a fallback for NULL

blocks.text: The variable begins as NULL. NVL supplies the text Guest instead.

blocks.text: Test missing values with IS NULL, not = NULL.
